condition: gaussian_kde raises LinAlgError (not positive definite) when the data is degenerate, i.e. lies in a lower-dimensional subspace or has a singular or near-singular covariance matrix.
workaround: Remove the linearly dependent dimensions before fitting, e.g. project the data onto its principal subspace. Another option is to add a little jitter or noise so the covariance matrix is non-singular.
